open_findings.subject: Scenario input v1 wire schema incomplete
open_findings.evidence: 117 specifies strict known-only event types; only machine JSON schema bundled is G0A1_SIM_POLICY_CORE_V1.schema.json (policy, not scenario). Exact envelope, all event discriminators and payload fields are not machine pinned.
open_findings.impact: Two parsers could disagree on whether events or unknown keys are valid; risk of inconsistent safety observations.
open_findings.resolution: Publish closed scenario v1 JSON Schema with exhaustive event types, shape/units, unknown field rejection, duplicate key validation pre-parser, BOOT semantics and resource bounds, matching R1; review as R1 compatible supplement.
open_findings.owner: SA + owner if any semantic extension

open_findings.subject: Virtual L/R mixer formula undefined
open_findings.evidence: 115 and 117 lock effort bounds and quantizer, but not a unique function mapping flap_demand, steering_demand into L/R.
open_findings.impact: Both implementations can satisfy bounds but produce different traces and control outputs.
open_findings.resolution: SA to select an explicit purely virtual mapping (coefficients, saturation order, sign convention, rounding, neutral and S1 hold) as a proposed R1.1 contract; owner review if changing expected behavior.

open_findings.subject: Trace record field schemas incomplete
open_findings.evidence: 118 fixes JSONL framing, hashing and required information but does not provide closed header/tick/terminal JSON Schemas with exact required/optional keys and versioned enum registry.
open_findings.impact: Two engines can make different hash bytes for identical semantics while appearing compliant.
open_findings.resolution: Create versioned strict trace schema with exact record-type tag, fields, null handling, comparator, reason-code order, terminal semantics, and deterministic replay vectors.

open_findings.subject: Scenario fault stimulus coverage incomplete
open_findings.evidence: R1 references critical power/scheduler/catastrophic conditions and VOLTAGE_WARNING_RECOVERABLE as a cause, yet 117 prohibits inventing v1 event types.
open_findings.impact: Some fault or recovery oracles cannot be represented end-to-end without a later schema revision.
open_findings.resolution: Mark unrepresentable cases DEFERRED; approve only types already present in v1, or version a formally reviewed v2 event input.

open_findings.subject: Runtime trust provisioner remains hypothetical
open_findings.evidence: 116 defines independent policy approval; the record explicitly says trusted runtime allowlist is not provisioned.
open_findings.impact: Design approval does not establish secure code execution or an installed host policy.
open_findings.resolution: Future implementation must pin the approved digest in an owner-controlled trusted medium, reject scenario self-approval, and test tamper negative vectors.

open_findings.subject: No code/evidence acceptance yet
open_findings.evidence: 120 and 121 mark all runtime oracles NOT RUN; Phase2.9 only checks doc bytes and JSON Schema for policy.
open_findings.impact: Nothing proves simulator correct, reproducible, or fail-closed at runtime.
open_findings.resolution: Later G1 acceptance must execute fixed oracles and capture complete evidence; preserve all IDs in traceability.

open_findings.subject: Nominal/full trace byte budget not proven
open_findings.evidence: 60s at 5ms yields up to 12001 evaluations including tick zero; 16MiB trace quota may be exceeded depending on record size and event count.
open_findings.impact: A valid long nominal scenario may end FAILED_INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE despite legal inputs.
open_findings.resolution: Do measured/bounded trace-size calculation against exact record schema; define documented failure cases, not silently increase approved 16MiB quota.
